node.statement: [transcribed 2026-07-27 from the upstream source read via git -C ../rs-mca show origin/main:experimental/notes/roadmaps/proof_sketch/s7_list_side.md#2, tagged 'PROVED-cited + verified']. THE QUOTIENT-CORE COUNT (thm:qcore): quotient cores produce at least C(n/M - 1, k/M) codewords at agreement k + sigma whenever M | k and sigma < M. The bound is independent of q — a pure combinatorial count with no norm threshold and no value-set collision question, the codewords being distinct by construction. Verified exponent: log2 C(n/M-1, k/M) ~ (n/M) H(rho).
